name: ncc-browser
description: A desktop browser that resolves services through Nostr Community Convention NCC-05 instead of DNS
author: imattau

scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run publisher:build && node scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run tor:fetch && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run tor:fetch -- linux-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb rpm flatpak --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run tor:fetch -- mac-x64 mac-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run tor:fetch -- win-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
